levered_single_stock_screen.reason: All required data is local: (1) the point-in-time megacap-liquidity menu (reports/research/iterations/h20260929_34_levered_single_stock/menu.parquet, built by scripts/build_h20260929_34_menu.py from data/sip/daily plus data/sip-delisted/daily plus data/sip-delisted/sp500_ticker_start_end_fja05680.csv, 6300 rows, 126 months 2016-04..2026-09, 134 unique symbols ever in the top 50); (2) BIL and SHY are already part of every screen_lane batch's base symbol set; (3) the synthetic L2_<SYM> series and any menu symbol missing from the currently-listed sip/daily archive (delisted since 2016) are constructed by this batch's own extend_panel hook from the same two local archives -- no external data dependency, no Alpaca live-trading-asset dependency for the historical evaluation itself.

data_gaps_confirmed.none: No data gap blocks any of the 14 candidates. Menu build and panel extension both run entirely off the local SIP daily archive (2016-01 onward) and the local delisted-membership CSV; no new external download was required this round.

panel_source: data/sip/daily/<year>/*.parquet (currently-listed) + data/sip-delisted/daily/*.parquet (delisted since 2016), loaded via screen_lane.load_batch_panel and this batch module's extend_panel hook (scripts/screen_batches/h20260929_34_levered_single_stock.py).
menu_source: reports/research/iterations/h20260929_34_levered_single_stock/menu.parquet, built by scripts/build_h20260929_34_menu.py: for each month-end trading day, the top 50 S&P 500 constituents (per data/sip-delisted/sp500_ticker_start_end_fja05680.csv point-in-time membership) ranked by trailing-63-session median dollar volume (close*volume), computed using only data up to and including that month-end date.

coverage_vs_windows.stress_2016_05_02_to_2023_09_15: covered from 2016-05-02 with the exception of ~4 weeks at the very start (menu's first month-end with a full 63-session trailing dollar-volume window is 2016-04-29); handled the same way `window_actual_start`/`first_valid_signal_date` handle any candidate whose data starts partway through a nominal window -- not a data gap requiring a caveat beyond what screen_lane already reports per candidate.

known_caveats.liquidity_proxy_not_market_cap: No local market-cap data exists; trailing 63-session median dollar volume is used as the size/liquidity proxy for 'megacap' menu construction. This is economically relevant to Alpaca executability but can diverge from a true market-cap ranking.
known_caveats.ticker_reuse_risk: A ticker symbol present in the currently-listed sip/daily archive is assumed to be the same company throughout its S&P 500 membership interval(s) in the point-in-time CSV; ticker reuse by an unrelated company after a 2016+ delisting is a known but unmitigated data-quality risk, consistent with prior iterations that use the same local archives.
known_caveats.vt40_single_pass_proxy: The vt40 volatility overlay is a single-pass proxy computed inside each candidate's own weights_fn (trailing 21-session realized vol of the current month's picks' historical returns, close-only, capped at 1.0x) rather than salvage.vol_scale's two-pass exact-simulated-book method, because screen_lane.ScreenCandidate.weights_fn receives only close, not open_. See cost-contract.json's vol_target_note.
